name: Aim
notes: Aim value clamped to 0..88; pointer/keys adjust it before click advances to PowerMeter

name: PowerMeter
notes: Power oscillates 0..1000 using difficulty speed 2/4/6 and direction +/-1; click locks power

name: LaunchSetup
notes: Quantizes aim to even degrees, computes initial speed power/3+500, initializes swing/flight fields

name: BallFlight
notes: Moves ball using cos/sin velocity and decays speed by max(10,int(speed*0.012)) until below 20

name: ResolveLanding
notes: Checks landing proximity against the three course-object target centers and records matched target

name: ScoreAndFeedback
notes: Updates shot score/result state and plays context-dependent voice feedback

name: ResetNextAttempt
notes: Restores initial ball position, clears power, decrements attempts remaining, resets direction, returns to Aim

name: SwingAnimationDelay
notes: Short 8x8 tick/frame delay between launch setup and active ball flight
